title: BinaryConfusionMatrix
description: Confusion matrix for binary classification models.

accuracy.description: The fraction of predictions given the correct label.

precision.description: The fraction of actual positive predictions that had positive actual labels.

trueNegatives.description: Number of true samples predicted as false.

truePositives.description: Number of true samples predicted as true.

f1Score.description: The equally weighted average of recall and precision.

positiveClassThreshold.description: Threshold value used when computing each of the following metric.

falseNegatives.description: Number of false samples predicted as false.

falsePositives.description: Number of false samples predicted as true.

recall.description: The fraction of actual positive labels that were given a positive prediction.
